title: Stream Reducer — Video & Podcast Summaries
excerpt: Read clear summaries of YouTube videos, Bilibili videos and podcasts. Explore key ideas, detailed notes and timestamped sources in English and Chinese.
content_html:
Less watching. More understanding.

Turn long videos and podcasts into clear, source-linked reading. Start with the key ideas, go deeper with detailed notes, and return to the exact moment in the original.

YouTube, Bilibili, Apple Podcasts & Xiaoyuzhou. Read public summaries without an account; sign in to save content and follow sources.

Popular picks

Popular English videos and podcasts, with a different creator in every pick.

Claude · 34K views

Shopify Gives Engineers Unlimited AI Tokens Under Barbell Strategy

Shopify CTO Mikhail Parakhin warns rival tech executives make a critical strategic error by capping developer tokens while wasting capital on unoptimized production models.

The Compound · 75.8K views

Fidelity's Chisholm Says Corporate Earnings Expansion Broadens Beyond Big Tech

Accelerating profit growth in the S&P 493 and low unit labor costs signal the current stock market rally remains in its early stages rather than a dot-com bubble.

Sabine Hossenfelder · 1.3M views

Quantum Superposition Yields Repulsive Gravity in New Physics Model

Destructive quantum interference from a mass in spatial superposition can impart an effective repulsive kick to probe particles, offering a pathway to prove gravity operates quantum mechanically if researchers can scale quantum coherence by six orders of magnitude.

The Ezra Klein Show · 1.2M views

Nolan Uses 'Odyssey' to Rebut Trump and Musk's Politics of Force

Christopher Nolan smuggles biblical ethics into Homer to argue that political disruption severed from moral restraint and mutual empathy collapses into ruin rather than civilizational renewal.

Joseph Carlson After Hours · 243.7K views

Burry Triples Down on Lululemon as Valuation Drops to 12 Times Profit

Lululemon trades at valuation levels pricing in terminal failure, creating asymmetric upside as aggressive share buybacks and durable brand loyalty outlast executive blunders.

Bloomberg Originals · 1.4M views

AI Infrastructure Shift Drives $1 Trillion Chip Supply Chain Overhaul

Exploding artificial intelligence demand and geopolitical chokepoints are forcing global governments and tech giants to spend hundreds of billions to overhaul advanced and foundational semiconductor manufacturing.

Acquired · 241.8K views

TSMC Founder Morris Chang Details Nvidia Disputes and Secret Apple Deals

TSMC's rise to a trillion-dollar monopoly was cemented by executing costly operational detours for Apple and enforcing a pure-play foundry model that strictly avoids competing with its own customers.

Scott Shi · 7.3K views

超长键膨胀击垮LSM内存索引 系统须设尺寸上限与布隆过滤器

当写入超长键时，LSM树内存块索引会因急剧膨胀耗尽物理内存并引发系统换页崩溃，底层存储必须设置硬性键长阈值并引入布隆过滤器以阻断空查导致的读放大。
